adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration copies existing SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts entries into embeddable_hosts via raw SQL (execute "INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)") without running EmbeddableHost validations or its before_validation normalization that strips http(s):// and paths. The new allowlist check (EmbeddableHost.record_for_host -> where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)) compares against the normalized uri.host, so any migrated rows containing a scheme, path, or stray \r characters from the old multiline setting can fail to match and effectively break allowed hosts.
